activity.message:
Merge pull request #5 from kosuke-satake/feat/message-protocol

Specify the brain-body message format and implement it on the body

Merge pull request #4 from kosuke-satake/docs/member-branches

Document personal branches for hardware members

Point the READMEs and guides to the message protocol

Stage 1 now has a defined message format, so the status lines move on
to choosing the parts, and the software guide names protocol.md as the
reference every implementation follows.

Add a line reader for serial input

Serial delivers bytes, not lines. The reader is fed whatever has
arrived and reports each complete line, so the main loop never waits.
A line that is too long or contains a NUL is dropped whole rather than
cut, so a truncated command can never be parsed as a valid one.

Parse velocity commands and format odometry on the body

Implements docs/protocol.md for the body side. The number check is
stricter than strtof, which would also accept exponents, hexadecimal,
nan and inf. A rejected line leaves the last command untouched, and an
invalid state produces no line rather than being reported as OK.

Specify the brain-body message format

Two line-based ASCII messages: V carries the velocity command from the
brain, O carries cumulative encoder ticks, battery voltage and state
from the body. Plain text keeps the format identical over UDP and
serial and lets anyone test the body by typing lines by hand. Receivers
ignore extra trailing fields, so fields can be appended later without
breaking older implementations.

Document personal branches for hardware members

The two hardware members are new to Git, so each keeps one branch and
commits to it from the browser instead of creating a branch per change.
Their work reaches main through pull requests from those branches, which
must stay alive after each merge.

Merge pull request #3 from kosuke-satake/chore/team-folder-structure

Organize the repository by team role and add folder guides

Allow budget figures and part models in the repository

The parts list needs models and prices, and the maintainer is fine with
publishing the budget. Personal devices such as the phone and computer
stay generic.

Describe the team folder layout in AGENTS.md and the READMEs

Agents must read a folder's guide before working in it and keep both
language versions current. The rule against empty folders stays, but a
new folder now arrives together with its guides.
